focus: 以能量、孔壓與鄰近振動證據評估動力夯實成效~Evaluate dynamic compaction through energy, pore pressure and neighbouring vibration evidence

units.anchor: 落錘位能尺度~Drop weight energy scale
units.title: 落錘位能尺度~Drop weight energy scale
units.mechanism: 動力夯實把落錘位能傳入地盤，但能量分配包含波傳、塑性變形及設備損失。位能不是衝擊峰值力，也不是直接的改善深度；施工參數必須由場址試夯建立。假設質量m=15000kg、落高h=15m，在理想條件下E=mgh=15000×9.81×15=2207250J=2.20725MJ，約2.21MJ。同樣位能在不同土層不會產生相同改善，若用能量達標取代孔壓與密實度驗證，軟弱夾層仍可能存在並在正式載重後造成差異沉陷。~Dynamic compaction transfers drop-weight energy into ground deformation, waves and losses. Potential energy is neither peak impact force nor improvement depth; field parameters require a site-specific trial. For mass m=15000kg and height h=15m, E=mgh=2207250J=2.20725MJ, approximately2.21MJ, before impact losses. Equal energy does not produce equal improvement in different soils. Energy compliance without pressure and density verification can leave weak layers that later cause differential settlement under permanent loading.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設質量m=15000kg、落高h=15m，在理想條件下E=mgh=15000×9.81×15=2207250J=2.20725MJ，約2.21MJ。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mass m=15000kg and height h=15m, E=mgh=2207250J=2.20725MJ, approximately2.21MJ, before impact losses.
units.verify: 核對設備質量與核准作業紀錄中的落高，將能量和試夯後測試結果配對。質量、吊具與安全作業由合格施工團隊管理，本算例僅供桌面能量分析。同時排除以下干擾原因：同樣位能在不同土層不會產生相同改善，若用能量達標取代孔壓與密實度驗證，軟弱夾層仍可能存在並在正式載重後造成差異沉陷。~Reconcile mass and recorded approved drop height, pairing energy with post-trial tests. Qualified construction personnel control equipment and lifting; the example supports desktop energy analysis only. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Equal energy does not produce equal improvement in different soils. Energy compliance without pressure and density verification can leave weak layers that later cause differential settlement under permanent loading.
units.failure: 同樣位能在不同土層不會產生相同改善，若用能量達標取代孔壓與密實度驗證，軟弱夾層仍可能存在並在正式載重後造成差異沉陷。~Equal energy does not produce equal improvement in different soils. Energy compliance without pressure and density verification can leave weak layers that later cause differential settlement under permanent loading.
units.misconception: 只要落錘位能尺度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for drop weight energy scale removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接落錘位能尺度時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。核對設備質量與核准作業紀錄中的落高，將能量和試夯後測試結果配對。質量、吊具與安全作業由合格施工團隊管理，本算例僅供桌面能量分析。~When handing over drop weight energy scale, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Reconcile mass and recorded approved drop height, pairing energy with post-trial tests. Qualified construction personnel control equipment and lifting; the example supports desktop energy analysis only.

units.anchor: 單位面積能量~Energy per treatment area
units.title: 單位面積能量~Energy per treatment area
units.mechanism: 能量應按夯點網格與遍數分配，不能只累計全場總量。平均面積能量有助比較試區，卻可能掩蓋網格間及場界的未處理區，需保留空間分布。假設每擊取四捨五入E=2.21MJ、同一25m²單元共10擊，EA=10×2.21/25=0.884MJ/m²；非均勻能量場的保證。若重複記錄同一夯點或以全場平均補償漏點，總能量看似足夠卻可能留下連續弱帶；載重跨越弱帶時，差異沉陷會比平均沉陷更嚴重。~Distribute energy by grid and pass rather than only total site energy. Average areal energy compares trials but may conceal gaps between points or at boundaries, requiring spatial records. Using rounded E=2.21MJ per impact, ten impacts over a25m² cell give EA=0.884MJ/m², without guaranteeing uniform spatial delivery. Duplicate records or site averages compensating for omitted points can conceal continuous weak bands. Loads crossing those bands may develop differential movement more consequential than the site's average settlement.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設每擊取四捨五入E=2.21MJ、同一25m²單元共10擊，EA=10×2.21/25=0.884MJ/m²；非均勻能量場的保證。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Using rounded E=2.21MJ per impact, ten impacts over a25m² cell give EA=0.884MJ/m², without guaranteeing uniform spatial delivery.
units.verify: 用坐標與時間記錄每次能量事件，和設計網格及遍數核對，再將測試點覆蓋到網格中間及邊緣。漏點須由試驗結果及設計責任人決定補充方案。同時排除以下干擾原因：若重複記錄同一夯點或以全場平均補償漏點，總能量看似足夠卻可能留下連續弱帶；載重跨越弱帶時，差異沉陷會比平均沉陷更嚴重。~Map each event by coordinates and time against the planned grid and passes. Place verification between points and at edges; the designer uses test results to resolve missed treatment areas. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Duplicate records or site averages compensating for omitted points can conceal continuous weak bands. Loads crossing those bands may develop differential movement more consequential than the site's average settlement.

Map each event by coordinates and time against the planned grid and passes. Place verification between points and at edges; the designer uses test results to resolve missed treatment areas.

units.anchor: 經驗改善深度~Empirical treatment depth
units.title: 經驗改善深度~Empirical treatment depth
units.mechanism: 改善深度的平方根經驗式依土類、能量效率及指定單位校準，係數不是通用無因次常數。它只能安排調查與試區尺度，不能取代深度分層的成效驗證。約定D以m、W以t、H以m，D=n√(WH)；選定經驗n=0.5、W=15t、H=15m得D=7.5m，不是保證改善深度。把噸改成公斤卻不轉換係數會大幅誇大深度；即使單位正確，硬殼或軟黏土夾層也可能阻隔能量，使經驗估算無法代表真正改善底界。~A square-root depth correlation depends on soil, efficiency and specified units. Its coefficient is not universally dimensionless; use it to plan investigations and trials rather than replace depth-specific verification. With D in metres, W in tonnes and H in metres, D=n√(WH). A calibrated-unit coefficient n=0.5, W=15t and H=15m give7.5m, not a guaranteed treatment depth. Changing tonnes to kilograms without changing the coefficient grossly inflates depth. Even consistent units cannot account automatically for a hard crust or soft clay lens that disrupts energy transfer.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：約定D以m、W以t、H以m，D=n√(WH)；選定經驗n=0.5、W=15t、H=15m得D=7.5m，不是保證改善深度。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With D in metres, W in tonnes and H in metres, D=n√(WH). A calibrated-unit coefficient n=0.5, W=15t and H=15m give7.5m, not a guaranteed treatment depth.
units.verify: 查明係數的試驗來源及單位慣例，於試區各深度比較施工前後貫入或其他核准測試。若深部未改變，須重查地層及排水條件，不只調整係數配合預期。同時排除以下干擾原因：把噸改成公斤卻不轉換係數會大幅誇大深度；即使單位正確，硬殼或軟黏土夾層也可能阻隔能量，使經驗估算無法代表真正改善底界。~Verify the coefficient's evidence and unit convention, comparing approved pre- and post-treatment tests at depth. Unchanged deep material requires reviewing stratigraphy and drainage instead of fitting the coefficient to the desired answer. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Changing tonnes to kilograms without changing the coefficient grossly inflates depth. Even consistent units cannot account automatically for a hard crust or soft clay lens that disrupts energy transfer.
units.failure: 把噸改成公斤卻不轉換係數會大幅誇大深度；即使單位正確，硬殼或軟黏土夾層也可能阻隔能量，使經驗估算無法代表真正改善底界。~Changing tonnes to kilograms without changing the coefficient grossly inflates depth. Even consistent units cannot account automatically for a hard crust or soft clay lens that disrupts energy transfer.

Verify the coefficient's evidence and unit convention, comparing approved pre- and post-treatment tests at depth. Unchanged deep material requires reviewing stratigraphy and drainage instead of fitting the coefficient to the desired answer.

units.anchor: 超額孔壓比例~Excess pressure ratio
units.title: 超額孔壓比例~Excess pressure ratio
units.mechanism: 飽和地盤受快速衝擊時可產生超額孔壓，使有效應力暫時降低。每一遍之間的排水恢復會影響後續效果，因此須將孔壓時間反應與能量紀錄一起分析。假設超額孔壓Δu=60kPa、初始有效垂直應力σ′v0=80kPa，ru=Δu/σ′v0=0.75；分母為初始有效應力而非總應力。若儀器取樣太慢，峰值可能被平均掉而誤判地盤已恢復；持續施加能量於高孔壓土層，可能增加側向移動而不是獲得預期密實效果。~Rapid impacts in saturated ground generate excess pressure and temporarily reduce effective stress. Drainage recovery between passes affects later performance, so analyse pressure histories alongside energy records. For excess Δu=60kPa and initial effective vertical stress σ′v0=80kPa, ru=0.75. The denominator is initial effective stress, not total stress. Slow sampling can average away peaks and suggest premature recovery. Continued impacts in highly pressurized soil may increase lateral movement rather than deliver the intended densification.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設超額孔壓Δu=60kPa、初始有效垂直應力σ′v0=80kPa，ru=Δu/σ′v0=0.75；分母為初始有效應力而非總應力。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For excess Δu=60kPa and initial effective vertical stress σ′v0=80kPa, ru=0.75. The denominator is initial effective stress, not total stress.
units.verify: 在代表性深度記錄孔壓峰值及消散，核對感測器動態範圍與時間同步。等待或轉換下一遍的條件須由試夯和穩定分析訂定，不直接採此教學比值。同時排除以下干擾原因：若儀器取樣太慢，峰值可能被平均掉而誤判地盤已恢復；持續施加能量於高孔壓土層，可能增加側向移動而不是獲得預期密實效果。~Record pressure peaks and dissipation at representative depths, checking sensor range and timing. Trial results and stability analysis establish hold or transition criteria rather than adopting the teaching ratio. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Slow sampling can average away peaks and suggest premature recovery. Continued impacts in highly pressurized soil may increase lateral movement rather than deliver the intended densification.
units.failure: 若儀器取樣太慢，峰值可能被平均掉而誤判地盤已恢復；持續施加能量於高孔壓土層，可能增加側向移動而不是獲得預期密實效果。~Slow sampling can average away peaks and suggest premature recovery. Continued impacts in highly pressurized soil may increase lateral movement rather than deliver the intended densification.
units.misconception: 只要超額孔壓比例符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for excess pressure ratio removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.

Record pressure peaks and dissipation at representative depths, checking sensor range and timing. Trial results and stability analysis establish hold or transition criteria rather than adopting the teaching ratio.

units.anchor: 鄰近振動衰減~Neighbouring vibration attenuation
units.title: 鄰近振動衰減~Neighbouring vibration attenuation
units.mechanism: 振動傳播受土層、頻率與建物條件影響，經驗距離式只能在校準範圍內比較。峰值粒子速度與加速度不同，單一數字也不能取代對脆弱設施的評估。假設已校準PPV(r)=8mm/s×(20m/r)^1.5，r=40m時PPV=2.83mm/s；指數1.5為選定擬合值，非普遍規律。單向感測器或未牢固耦合會低估真實峰值；若地層導波造成局部放大，單靠距離倍增即假設安全會漏掉遠處敏感設施的較大反應。~Ground layers, frequency and structures affect vibration. A distance correlation is valid only within its calibration range; peak particle velocity differs from acceleration and cannot alone establish acceptability for sensitive assets. For calibrated PPV(r)=8mm/s×(20m/r)^1.5, r=40m gives2.83mm/s. The exponent1.5 is a selected fit, not a universal law. A poorly coupled or single-axis sensor can underread the peak. Guided waves may amplify remote response, making an assumed safety benefit from distance alone unreliable for sensitive facilities.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已校準PPV(r)=8mm/s×(20m/r)^1.5，r=40m時PPV=2.83mm/s；指數1.5為選定擬合值，非普遍規律。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For calibrated PPV(r)=8mm/s×(20m/r)^1.5, r=40m gives2.83mm/s. The exponent1.5 is a selected fit, not a universal law.
units.verify: 用三向地震檢波器記錄波形、頻率與距離，在代表性方位建立現地關係。鄰近管線及歷史建物的允許條件由權責工程師依狀態和規範決定。同時排除以下干擾原因：單向感測器或未牢固耦合會低估真實峰值；若地層導波造成局部放大，單靠距離倍增即假設安全會漏掉遠處敏感設施的較大反應。~Record three-axis waveforms, frequencies and distances to establish site relations in representative directions. Responsible engineers set limits for nearby utilities and heritage structures using their condition and applicable guidance. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A poorly coupled or single-axis sensor can underread the peak. Guided waves may amplify remote response, making an assumed safety benefit from distance alone unreliable for sensitive facilities.

Record three-axis waveforms, frequencies and distances to establish site relations in representative directions. Responsible engineers set limits for nearby utilities and heritage structures using their condition and applicable guidance.

units.anchor: 夯坑幾何估量~Crater geometry estimate
units.title: 夯坑幾何估量~Crater geometry estimate
units.mechanism: 夯坑體積反映表面形狀改變，但不能直接等於深層孔隙體積減少。隆起、回填與土體側移需要另行平衡，使用簡化圓錐前應先檢查坑形是否相符。假設圓錐坑半徑r=1.5m、深h=0.6m，V=πr²h/3=1.414m³，約1.41m³；不代表相同體積的密實量。深坑也可能來自側向擠土或表層破壞，而不表示深部改善；只追求坑深會忽略鄰近隆起、地下管線變形及不均勻回填形成的次生沉陷。~Crater volume describes surface geometry rather than directly measuring deep void reduction. Heave, backfill and lateral movement need separate accounting; verify shape before adopting a cone approximation. For an ideal conical crater with r=1.5m and h=0.6m, V=πr²h/3=1.414m³, about1.41m³, not the same volume of densification. A deep crater may reflect lateral extrusion or surface failure rather than deep improvement. Pursuing depth alone overlooks surrounding heave, utility deformation and secondary settlement from uneven backfill.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設圓錐坑半徑r=1.5m、深h=0.6m，V=πr²h/3=1.414m³，約1.41m³；不代表相同體積的密實量。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For an ideal conical crater with r=1.5m and h=0.6m, V=πr²h/3=1.414m³, about1.41m³, not the same volume of densification.
units.verify: 以地表測量網比較施工前後三維形狀，記錄坑周隆起及回填量。將體積平衡與深層試驗一起使用，坑形偏離圓錐時改用實測地形積分。同時排除以下干擾原因：深坑也可能來自側向擠土或表層破壞，而不表示深部改善；只追求坑深會忽略鄰近隆起、地下管線變形及不均勻回填形成的次生沉陷。~Survey three-dimensional surfaces before and after treatment, recording rim heave and backfill. Combine volume balance with deep tests, using measured surface integration when shape differs from a cone. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A deep crater may reflect lateral extrusion or surface failure rather than deep improvement. Pursuing depth alone overlooks surrounding heave, utility deformation and secondary settlement from uneven backfill.

Survey three-dimensional surfaces before and after treatment, recording rim heave and backfill. units.anchor: 乾密度與含水~Dry density and moisture
units.title: 乾密度與含水~Dry density and moisture
units.mechanism: 密實度評估須分清乾土質量與含水質量，試樣體積與代表性同樣重要。單一點位乾密度不能代表整個深度或面積，應配合分層測試與含水狀態判讀。假設乾土質量Md=1800kg、體積V=1m³，ρd=Md/V=1800kg/m³；若量得濕質量，必須先按含水率換算。若把濕質量直接計為乾密度，含水較高區會顯得更密實；這種假改善可能掩蓋孔壓未消散與土骨架鬆散，導致錯誤驗收地盤承載狀態。~Distinguish dry mass from wet mass when evaluating density, with reliable volume and representative sampling. One result does not characterize the full area or depth and needs layered tests and moisture context. For dry mass Md=1800kg and volume V=1m³, ρd=1800kg/m³. A measured wet mass must first be corrected using water content. Using wet mass as dry mass makes wetter soil appear denser. That false improvement can conceal remaining pore pressure and loose fabric, leading to incorrect acceptance of foundation conditions.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設乾土質量Md=1800kg、體積V=1m³，ρd=Md/V=1800kg/m³；若量得濕質量，必須先按含水率換算。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For dry mass Md=1800kg and volume V=1m³, ρd=1800kg/m³. A measured wet mass must first be corrected using water content.
units.verify: 依核准方法取得代表試樣與含水率，保存取樣深度及體積校正。對照相關規格及試驗不確定性，將不易取樣區明列而非用附近單點值填補。同時排除以下干擾原因：若把濕質量直接計為乾密度，含水較高區會顯得更密實；這種假改善可能掩蓋孔壓未消散與土骨架鬆散，導致錯誤驗收地盤承載狀態。~Obtain representative samples and moisture by approved methods, retaining depth and volume calibration. Compare with relevant specifications and uncertainty, explicitly marking difficult-to-sample areas instead of substituting one nearby result. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Using wet mass as dry mass makes wetter soil appear denser. That false improvement can conceal remaining pore pressure and loose fabric, leading to incorrect acceptance of foundation conditions.

units.practice: 交接乾密度與含水時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。依核准方法取得代表試樣與含水率，保存取樣深度及體積校正。對照相關規格及試驗不確定性，將不易取樣區明列而非用附近單點值填補。~When handing over dry density and moisture, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Obtain representative samples and moisture by approved methods, retaining depth and volume calibration. units.anchor: 平板反力剛度~Plate response stiffness
units.title: 平板反力剛度~Plate response stiffness
units.mechanism: 平板載重的壓力沉陷比是試驗尺度下的反力指標，受板尺寸與受力深度影響。它不是土壤楊氏模數，也不應直接外推到大型基礎的深層沉陷。假設壓力q=200kPa、沉陷s=0.010m，k=q/s=20000kPa/m=20MPa/m；單位為壓力除長度，非MPa。表面硬殼可讓小平板呈現高剛度，下面軟層卻未改善；將此反力係數當材料常數會低估大面積載重沉陷，造成對施工成果過度樂觀。~A plate's pressure-settlement ratio is a test-scale response influenced by plate size and stressed depth. It is not soil Young's modulus and cannot directly predict deeper settlement under a large foundation. For q=200kPa and s=0.010m, k=q/s=20000kPa/m=20MPa/m. Its unit is pressure per length, not MPa. A surface crust can stiffen a small plate while soft material remains below. Treating its response coefficient as a material constant understates settlement under larger loads and overstates treatment success.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設壓力q=200kPa、沉陷s=0.010m，k=q/s=20000kPa/m=20MPa/m；單位為壓力除長度，非MPa。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For q=200kPa and s=0.010m, k=q/s=20000kPa/m=20MPa/m. Its unit is pressure per length, not MPa.
units.verify: 保存完整載重卸載曲線與持荷時間，核對板尺寸、基底整平及位移基準。以相同試驗條件比較前後改善，深層承載及沉陷另由地層模型檢核。同時排除以下干擾原因：表面硬殼可讓小平板呈現高剛度，下面軟層卻未改善；將此反力係數當材料常數會低估大面積載重沉陷，造成對施工成果過度樂觀。~Retain complete load-unload curves, hold times, plate dimensions and displacement references. Compare treatment under consistent conditions and evaluate deep bearing and settlement separately through the ground model. Also rule out the following competing explanation: A surface crust can stiffen a small plate while soft material remains below. Treating its response coefficient as a material constant understates settlement under larger loads and overstates treatment success.
units.failure: 表面硬殼可讓小平板呈現高剛度，下面軟層卻未改善；將此反力係數當材料常數會低估大面積載重沉陷，造成對施工成果過度樂觀。~A surface crust can stiffen a small plate while soft material remains below. Treating its response coefficient as a material constant understates settlement under larger loads and overstates treatment success.
units.misconception: 只要平板反力剛度符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for plate response stiffness removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接平板反力剛度時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。保存完整載重卸載曲線與持荷時間，核對板尺寸、基底整平及位移基準。以相同試驗條件比較前後改善，深層承載及沉陷另由地層模型檢核。~When handing over plate response stiffness, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Retain complete load-unload curves, hold times, plate dimensions and displacement references. Compare treatment under consistent conditions and evaluate deep bearing and settlement separately through the ground model.

units.anchor: 設備接地壓力~Equipment ground contact pressure
units.title: 設備接地壓力~Equipment ground contact pressure
units.mechanism: 施工設備作用地盤的接觸壓力影響作業平台穩定，和改善後永久地盤能力是不同問題。平均壓力不含履帶端部集中、動態反力或偏心，平台需獨立設計。假設設備垂直荷載P=1000kN、總有效接觸A=2m²，q=P/A=500kPa；此為靜態平均值，不是平台許可壓力。接觸面積若因不平整或坑邊只剩一部分，實際壓力可遠高於平均值；即使場地已改良，局部平台破壞仍可能造成設備傾斜與連鎖風險。~Equipment contact pressure governs working-platform stability, separately from improved permanent-ground capacity. Average pressure excludes track-edge concentration, dynamic reactions and eccentricity, requiring a dedicated platform design. For vertical equipment load P=1000kN over effective A=2m², q=500kPa. This is static average pressure, not allowable platform bearing pressure. Uneven ground or a crater edge can reduce contact area and raise actual pressure well above average. Local platform failure can tilt equipment even on generally improved ground, creating wider hazards.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設設備垂直荷載P=1000kN、總有效接觸A=2m²，q=P/A=500kPa；此為靜態平均值，不是平台許可壓力。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For vertical equipment load P=1000kN over effective A=2m², q=500kPa. This is static average pressure, not allowable platform bearing pressure.
units.verify: 核對實際接觸面積與設備工況，將平台厚度、排水及下伏軟層納入審查。平台驗收與日常檢查由施工及岩土責任人完成，異常沉陷應先處理再作業。同時排除以下干擾原因：接觸面積若因不平整或坑邊只剩一部分，實際壓力可遠高於平均值；即使場地已改良，局部平台破壞仍可能造成設備傾斜與連鎖風險。~Review actual contact and equipment states alongside platform thickness, drainage and underlying soft layers. Construction and geotechnical leads approve and inspect the platform; abnormal settlement requires resolution before operation. Also rule out the following competing explanation: Uneven ground or a crater edge can reduce contact area and raise actual pressure well above average. Local platform failure can tilt equipment even on generally improved ground, creating wider hazards.
units.failure: 接觸面積若因不平整或坑邊只剩一部分，實際壓力可遠高於平均值；即使場地已改良，局部平台破壞仍可能造成設備傾斜與連鎖風險。~Uneven ground or a crater edge can reduce contact area and raise actual pressure well above average. Local platform failure can tilt equipment even on generally improved ground, creating wider hazards.
units.misconception: 只要設備接地壓力符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for equipment ground contact pressure removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接設備接地壓力時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。核對實際接觸面積與設備工況，將平台厚度、排水及下伏軟層納入審查。平台驗收與日常檢查由施工及岩土責任人完成，異常沉陷應先處理再作業。~When handing over equipment ground contact pressure, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Review actual contact and equipment states alongside platform thickness, drainage and underlying soft layers. Construction and geotechnical leads approve and inspect the platform; abnormal settlement requires resolution before operation.

units.anchor: 貫入阻力改善比~Penetration resistance gain
units.title: 貫入阻力改善比~Penetration resistance gain
units.mechanism: 施工前後貫入阻力比可顯示改變，但受有效應力、孔壓、測試位置及土層分類影響。成效判讀應檢查完整深度剖面，不能只報全場最大的改善倍率。假設同層可比較錐阻力qc由6MPa增至12MPa，比值12/6=2；兩倍錐阻力不是兩倍承載力或所有土層合格。前後測點若落在不同土層，倍數可只是空間差異；只展示好看的結果會掩蓋深部薄弱帶，使上部結構在使用期承受未預期的差異沉陷。~Pre- and post-treatment penetration ratios show change but depend on effective stress, pressure, location and soil type. Evaluate full depth profiles instead of reporting only the largest site-wide gain. For comparable same-layer cone resistance rising from6MPa to12MPa, the ratio is2. Doubled cone resistance is not doubled bearing capacity or acceptance of all strata. If the two tests intercept different layers, the ratio may reflect spatial variation alone. Selecting favourable results conceals weak bands that later impose unexpected differential settlement on the structure.
units.model: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設同層可比較錐阻力qc由6MPa增至12MPa，比值12/6=2；兩倍錐阻力不是兩倍承載力或所有土層合格。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For comparable same-layer cone resistance rising from6MPa to12MPa, the ratio is2. Doubled cone resistance is not doubled bearing capacity or acceptance of all strata.
units.verify: 配對前後測線與高程，檢查等待孔壓消散時間、探頭校正及土層變化。對低增幅區保留原始剖面與原因分析，依工程目標逐區簽認而非平均通過。同時排除以下干擾原因：前後測點若落在不同土層，倍數可只是空間差異；只展示好看的結果會掩蓋深部薄弱帶，使上部結構在使用期承受未預期的差異沉陷。~Match before-and-after locations and levels, checking dissipation time, calibration and stratigraphy. Retain raw profiles and explanations for low-gain zones, accepting against project objectives zone by zone rather than by the average. Also rule out the following competing explanation: If the two tests intercept different layers, the ratio may reflect spatial variation alone. Selecting favourable results conceals weak bands that later impose unexpected differential settlement on the structure.
units.failure: 前後測點若落在不同土層，倍數可只是空間差異；只展示好看的結果會掩蓋深部薄弱帶，使上部結構在使用期承受未預期的差異沉陷。~If the two tests intercept different layers, the ratio may reflect spatial variation alone. Selecting favourable results conceals weak bands that later impose unexpected differential settlement on the structure.
units.misconception: 只要貫入阻力改善比符合名義數值，就能略過邊界條件與獨立驗證。~A nominal result for penetration resistance gain removes the need to check boundaries and independent evidence.
units.practice: 交接貫入阻力改善比時保存原始紀錄、單位與基準。配對前後測線與高程，檢查等待孔壓消散時間、探頭校正及土層變化。對低增幅區保留原始剖面與原因分析，依工程目標逐區簽認而非平均通過。~When handing over penetration resistance gain, retain original records, units and reference conditions. Match before-and-after locations and levels, checking dissipation time, calibration and stratigraphy. Retain raw profiles and explanations for low-gain zones, accepting against project objectives zone by zone rather than by the average.

title: 動力夯實地盤改良~Dynamic compaction of ground
summary: 本課聚焦以能量、孔壓與鄰近振動證據評估動力夯實成效。十個單元依序辨識作用機制、量化假設、驗證程序與故障徵兆，讓學徒追蹤從原始資料到工程判斷的每一環。每個算例都帶單位與限制，不把局部成功或單一比值當成完整系統合格。交接須保留基準、異常與權責工程師核准的條件。~This course focuses on evaluate dynamic compaction through energy, pore pressure and neighbouring vibration evidence. Ten units connect mechanisms, numerical assumptions, verification procedures and failure symptoms so apprentices can trace each inference from evidence to judgment. Every example includes units and limitations; one successful observation or ratio does not establish system acceptance. Handover retains datums, anomalies and conditions approved by the responsible engineer.
example: 以下為原創教學算例，所有輸入均為假設，不是地標實測。教學假設，非現場設定值：假設質量m=15000kg、落高h=15m，在理想條件下E=mgh=15000×9.81×15=2207250J=2.20725MJ，約2.21MJ。假設落高15m固定，質量由15000增加10%至16500kg，位能由2.20725增為2.427975MJ，約2.428MJ；能量增加10%不等於改善深度增加10%，也不授權改變現場吊重。先列出符號、單位及固定條件，再以獨立計算器核算。敏感度只描述這個模型中的輸入改變；若邊界或物理機制改變，應重建模型而非線性外推。最後把計算值、量測不確定性及需進一步驗證的項目分列，由責任工程師決定能否支持下一階段。~The following original example uses assumptions rather than landmark measurements. Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mass m=15000kg and height h=15m, E=mgh=2207250J=2.20725MJ, approximately2.21MJ, before impact losses. At fixed15m height, raising assumed mass from15000 to16500kg by10% changes potential energy from2.20725 to2.427975MJ, about2.428MJ. Ten percent more energy is not ten percent more treatment depth and does not authorize changing field lifting loads. First tabulate symbols, units and fixed conditions, then check the arithmetic independently. Sensitivity describes an input change inside this model only. Changed boundaries or physical mechanisms require a new model rather than linear extrapolation. Finally distinguish the calculated result, measurement uncertainty and evidence still needed; the responsible engineer decides whether the conclusion supports a next stage.
history: 本課以公開工程研究與機構文件建立以能量、孔壓與鄰近振動證據評估動力夯實成效的背景。美國聯邦公路管理局列出粒料柱設計手冊（1985）。美國聯邦公路管理局出版動力夯實手冊（1995）。地盤改良第一冊更新深層夯實方法背景（2017）。兩個地標用來比較環境、量測與維護證據，並非宣稱本課每一教學構件都實際用於兩處。來源若只可讀摘要，適用範圍已另行註明；現場設計須重新確認規範版本與責任。本課只重建公開原理。~This course uses public research and institutional documents to establish context for evaluate dynamic compaction through energy, pore pressure and neighbouring vibration evidence. FHWA lists its aggregate-column design manual (1985). FHWA publishes its dynamic-compaction manual (1995). Ground Modification Volume I updates deep-compaction context (2017). The two landmarks compare environments, measurements and maintenance evidence; they do not imply that every teaching component was installed at both sites. Abstract-only access is declared in source scopes. Field design requires current applicability and responsible review. This course reconstructs public principles only.
facts: 教學假設，非現場設定值：假設質量m=15000kg、落高h=15m，在理想條件下E=mgh=15000×9.81×15=2207250J=2.20725MJ，約2.21MJ。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For mass m=15000kg and height h=15m, E=mgh=2207250J=2.20725MJ, approximately2.21MJ, before impact losses.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設每擊取四捨五入E=2.21MJ、同一25m²單元共10擊，EA=10×2.21/25=0.884MJ/m²；非均勻能量場的保證。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: Using rounded E=2.21MJ per impact, ten impacts over a25m² cell give EA=0.884MJ/m², without guaranteeing uniform spatial delivery.

教學假設，非現場設定值：約定D以m、W以t、H以m，D=n√(WH)；選定經驗n=0.5、W=15t、H=15m得D=7.5m，不是保證改善深度。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: With D in metres, W in tonnes and H in metres, D=n√(WH). A calibrated-unit coefficient n=0.5, W=15t and H=15m give7.5m, not a guaranteed treatment depth.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設超額孔壓Δu=60kPa、初始有效垂直應力σ′v0=80kPa，ru=Δu/σ′v0=0.75；分母為初始有效應力而非總應力。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For excess Δu=60kPa and initial effective vertical stress σ′v0=80kPa, ru=0.75. The denominator is initial effective stress, not total stress.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設已校準PPV(r)=8mm/s×(20m/r)^1.5，r=40m時PPV=2.83mm/s；指數1.5為選定擬合值，非普遍規律。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For calibrated PPV(r)=8mm/s×(20m/r)^1.5, r=40m gives2.83mm/s. The exponent1.5 is a selected fit, not a universal law.

教學假設，非現場設定值：假設圓錐坑半徑r=1.5m、深h=0.6m，V=πr²h/3=1.414m³，約1.41m³；不代表相同體積的密實量。~Teaching assumptions, not field settings: For an ideal conical crater with r=1.5m and h=0.6m, V=πr²h/3=1.414m³, about1.41m³, not the same volume of densification.
